parole.significato: lot (US), parcel (of land), plot, piece of ground (an area or land used for building on or planting on)
parole.testo: The etymology is disputed. It has been derived in at least three ways: * From the same Proto-Finno-Ugric root as the verb telik (“to fill”). * From tel (“ground, soil”) + -k (noun suffix).
